iron_man.description: Tony Stark fights in a nanotech Iron Man suit, combining flight, repulsor weapons, adaptive armor and battlefield engineering.

thanos.description: Thanos is a massively strong and durable Titan strategist who overwhelms opponents with armor, skill and a double-edged blade.

captain_america.description: Steve Rogers is an enhanced soldier and master tactician whose vibranium shield supports precise offense, defense and team leadership.

thor.description: Thor channels lightning through Stormbreaker and combines godlike strength, flight, durability and centuries of combat experience.

hulk.description: Bruce Banner transforms into Hulk, a gamma-powered brawler whose tremendous strength and durability make close combat extremely dangerous.

scarlet_witch.description: Wanda Maximoff uses chaos magic, telekinesis and mental influence to attack, restrain, shield and reshape a battlefield.

doctor_strange.description: Stephen Strange is a master of the mystic arts who uses portals, binding spells, magical shields and dimensional tactics.

spider_man.description: Peter Parker combines spider-like strength, speed, wall-crawling, web technology and danger-sensing reflexes.

black_panther.description: T'Challa is a master martial artist protected by a vibranium suit that stores and releases kinetic energy.

captain_marvel.description: Carol Danvers flies at extreme speed, projects photon energy and possesses exceptional strength and durability.

loki.description: Loki mixes Asgardian physical ability with illusions, disguise, deception and precise dagger combat.

hawkeye.description: Clint Barton is an elite archer and field operative who uses precision shots and specialized trick arrows.

black_widow.description: Natasha Romanoff relies on espionage training, acrobatics, tactical weapons and close-quarters combat.

vision.description: Vision is a synthezoid who can fly, alter his density and project energy through the Mind Stone.

winter_soldier.description: Bucky Barnes combines super-soldier conditioning, military training, firearms and a powerful vibranium arm.

ant_man.description: Scott Lang uses Pym technology to shrink, grow, communicate with ants and turn size changes into tactical strikes.

wasp.description: Hope van Dyne combines shrinking technology, winged flight, bio-electric stingers and precise martial arts.

falcon.description: Sam Wilson uses a vibranium flight suit, drone support and aerial maneuvering to control distance and protect allies.

war_machine.description: James Rhodes operates heavily armed armor built for sustained firepower, flight and battlefield support.

shang_chi.description: Shang-Chi is an elite martial artist empowered by the Ten Rings for ranged attacks, defense and enhanced movement.

moon_knight.description: Marc Spector serves Khonshu with supernatural resilience, combat skill, crescent weapons and a protective suit.

daredevil.description: Matt Murdock uses heightened senses, radar-like awareness, acrobatics and billy clubs to fight at close range.

star_lord.description: Peter Quill combines quick thinking, jet boots, blasters and team tactics as leader of the Guardians.

gamora.description: Gamora is a highly trained assassin with enhanced strength, agility and deadly sword technique.

drax.description: Drax is a relentless close-range fighter with exceptional strength, durability and twin-knife skill.

groot.description: Groot grows and reshapes his body into branches, shields and restraints while rapidly regenerating damage.

rocket.description: Rocket is a brilliant engineer and marksman who turns advanced weapons, traps and explosives into battlefield advantages.

nebula.description: Nebula is a heavily modified cyborg with enhanced durability, weapon systems and elite hand-to-hand training.

mantis.description: Mantis senses and influences emotions and can induce sleep through physical contact.

ultron.description: Ultron is an adaptive artificial intelligence with a vibranium body, flight, energy weapons and machine-network control.

hela.description: Hela possesses immense Asgardian power and can manifest deadly necroswords and weapons at will.

gorr.description: Gorr wields the Necrosword to gain superhuman power, create shadow monsters and threaten gods.

ancient_one.description: The Ancient One is a master sorcerer skilled in astral projection, dimensional manipulation, portals and magical defense.

agatha.description: Agatha Harkness is an experienced witch who drains magic, casts binding spells and controls battles with runes.

america_chavez.description: America Chavez uses superhuman strength and star-shaped portals to travel and strike across the multiverse.

wong.description: Wong is a disciplined master sorcerer who specializes in portals, bindings, shields and coordinated magical defense.

valkyrie.description: Valkyrie is an elite Asgardian combatant with enhanced physical ability, aerial experience and mastery of Dragonfang.

heimdall.description: Heimdall combines Asgardian power and swordsmanship with extraordinary senses that perceive distant events.

sif.description: Lady Sif is an accomplished Asgardian warrior skilled with sword and shield and hardened by centuries of battle.

red_guardian.description: Alexei Shostakov is a powerful super-soldier who relies on strength, grappling and shield-based brawling.

yelena.description: Yelena Belova is an elite covert operative trained in firearms, batons, acrobatics and close-quarters combat.

taskmaster.description: Antonia Dreykov analyzes and reproduces observed fighting styles while using a versatile arsenal of copied weapons.

echo.description: Maya Lopez is a skilled close-quarters fighter whose focus, observation and ancestral empowerment support powerful counters.

kingpin.description: Wilson Fisk is a calculating crime lord with exceptional physical strength, toughness and brutal close-range technique.

kate_bishop.description: Kate Bishop is a precise archer and agile fighter who uses trick arrows, improvisation and fast tactical decisions.

she_hulk.description: Jennifer Walters retains her intelligence while transformed and combines gamma strength, durability and controlled brawling.

abomination.description: Emil Blonsky's Abomination form delivers enormous gamma-powered strength, durability and aggressive close-range attacks.

killmonger.description: Erik Killmonger is an elite soldier and tactician enhanced by the Heart-Shaped Herb and a kinetic vibranium suit.

okoye.description: Okoye is a master Wakandan warrior whose vibranium spear, discipline and tactical awareness challenge stronger opponents.

namor.description: Namor combines immense strength, underwater resilience and winged flight with expert spear combat.

shuri.description: Shuri combines scientific genius, sonic technology and the Black Panther's enhanced senses, agility and vibranium suit.

rescue.description: Pepper Potts operates the Rescue armor for high-speed flight, protection, repulsor attacks and coordinated aerial support.
